L_function: L(s, chi), chi = (n/5) the Legendre symbol mod 5 (real, even, primitive; Conrey label 5.4)
functional_equation: Lambda(s) = (5/pi)^{s/2} Gamma(s/2) L(s,chi) = Lambda(1-s), root number tau(chi)/sqrt5 = 1
theta: theta_chi(t) = (t/2) log(5/pi) + Im logGamma(1/4 + i t/2)
Z: Z_chi(t) = exp(i theta_chi(t)) L(1/2+it, chi), real
N_smooth: theta_chi(T)/pi = (T/2pi) log(5T/(2 pi e)) - 1/8 + O(1/T); N(T) = N_smooth(T) + S(T)
error_semantics: rigorous: for each n, the n-th zero ordinate gamma_n satisfies |gamma_n - stored_n| < eps_n <= max_error, certified by opposite ball-arithmetic signs of Z_chi at stored_n -+ eps_n (eps_n = ulp/2 + 1e-15)

certification.statement: every zero of L(s,(n/5)) with 0 < Im s <= 1000 is simple, has Re s = 1/2 and is one of the 904 stored ordinates (to within its eps); the counts below agree
certification.method: sign changes of Z_chi in Arb ball arithmetic (python-flint acb.dirichlet_l) on a grid; counts by the argument principle in ball arithmetic: (A) winding number of L around [1/2-3, 1/2+3] x [1, T] (no functional equation) plus [-2.5,3.5]x[-1,1] (= 2 trivial zeros); (B) N(T) = theta_chi(T)/pi + S(T) with S(T) from the certified arg of L on 7/2+iT -> 1/2+iT (functional equation, root number 1); segment test: order-6 Taylor model with box remainder, values in a convex set avoiding 0

reality_check.note: the Im Z_chi ball contains 0 at every grid point (else the run aborts)

independent_mpmath_check.method: mpmath.findroot on Re[exp(i theta) mpmath.dirichlet(1/2+it, chi)] at 30 digits
